failedAssertions.reason: Profile redirect to /start works correctly, but no 'profile required' banner is displayed on the /start page. The React ProfileSettingsPage component does not read the router location.state.from value to show a notification. The legacy start.html had this feature via a query parameter and a dedicated banner div.
failedAssertions.suggestedFix: Add a useEffect in ProfileSettingsPage that checks location.state?.from and displays a toast or banner notification informing the user that a profile is required to access that page.

appliedUpdates.description: Added friction about collapsed center column sidebar intercepting pointer events on PDF section buttons (VAL-PROMO-008). Must expand Email Tools column before interacting with PDF elements.

Added friction about PDF upload area using a div with role='button' instead of a file input. Upload requires programmatically finding hidden input[type='file'] and using DataTransfer API + change event dispatch.
Added friction about radio button interaction via agent-browser being unreliable due to Playwright strict mode / overlay detection. Workaround: use eval-based element.click().
Added note that company email field requires @citizenwatchgroup.com domain for management positions.
